For a 4-night business stay in Gurugram, these are concrete offers currently showing in India. Prices below are per room/night × 4; verify the final tax-inclusive total at checkout.

Holiday Inn Express Gurugram Sector 50, an IHG Hotel — ₹3,591/night ≈ ₹14,364/4 nights. Breakfast and Wi-Fi included. Limitation: smaller, budget-oriented rooms; cancellation terms depend on the selected rate. 
Ixigo

Radisson Hotel Gurugram Sohna Road City Center — ₹4,225/night ≈ ₹16,900/4 nights on a comparable Gurugram listing. Free Wi-Fi; breakfast is available, but confirm that your selected rate includes it. Flexible cancellation varies by rate. 
Ixigo

Hyatt Place Gurgaon Udyog Vihar — check the live breakfast-inclusive refundable rate before paying. It is positioned specifically for Udyog Vihar/Cyber City business travel and offers Wi-Fi and business services. 
Google

Verify: GST-inclusive total, breakfast for all 4 mornings, cancellation deadline/refund, prepayment requirement, and whether Wi-Fi is complimentary.
